sql: SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id, (SELECT MIN(d.A11) FROM client fc JOIN district d ON fc.district_id = d.district_id WHERE fc.gender = 'F') as lowest_salary, (SELECT MAX(d.A11) FROM client fc JOIN district d ON fc.district_id = d.district_id WHERE fc.gender = 'F') as highest_salary, (SELECT MAX(d.A11) - MIN(d.A11) FROM client fc JOIN district d ON fc.district_id = d.district_id WHERE fc.gender = 'F') as salary_gap FROM client c JOIN disp ON c.client_id = disp.client_id JOIN account a ON disp.account_id = a.account_id WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
